checks.finding: Exact Fraction stage amounts separately retain input, binding, internal, translation and wall energy. Net thermal cancellation does not zero their cumulative additions.

Coverage and temperature are independently advanced through all four RK4 stages. No analytic N-to-T relation or old evolution method is called.
Each segment passes its own constant power to all four stages, including its final stage. The next segment uses its new power and carries forward the same evolved N/T and cumulative state.

Segments must exactly cover [0,duration] with float-equal adjacency and no gap or overlap. Each shared boundary is sampled only after the preceding segment. Prescribed input rejects times outside support.

Logical step times use exact rational start+(stop-start)*step/steps. Nearest-float sample times must advance; segment index/step preserve the logical coordinate. No held or extrapolated power tail is created.
_real rejects the original negative value before float conversion, then rejects nonfinite values and positive input underflow. _time rejects loss of exact caller-supplied coordinates.

Nonzero float projections reject underflow/overflow; positive cumulative stagnation, nonzero state stagnation, exhaustion and intermediate temperature/coverage domain exits reject. Exact Fraction stage products are retained until projection.

Wall thermal change minus external input plus total wall debit is reported as a residual. Bound reference is -D*N; gas receives supplied internal plus 2*k_B*T translation. Total residual is wall thermal plus bound-reference change plus gas minus input.
Per-parent eV costs use the exact declared elementary-charge conversion. Dynamics and channels are per area; patch area enters once in extensive sample output.

numeric_method.scope: Fresh zero-activation-energy reference for four fixed manufactured cases and seven saved trajectories; no numerical core imports/calls.
numeric_method.parameter_projection: Problem and schedule endpoint/power inputs first receive float64 projection; Decimal.from_float retains those represented coefficients. kB=1.380649e-23 and eV=1.602176634e-19 are exact declared SI decimals.
numeric_method.logical_time: Original segment endpoints are exact represented-Fractions. Logical time is start+(stop-start)*segment_step/steps. Reference dictionaries use those exact Fractions; Decimal conversion uses the declared precision. Rounded time_s stamps are checked separately and never redefine schedule support.
numeric_method.inventory: Exact N=N0exp(-nu*t), M=-N0expm1(-nu*t); zero barrier is mandatory.
numeric_method.temperature: T=(T0+A)exp(-B(t))-A+sum_segments P/C*integral exp[B(s)-B(t)]ds, A=(D+I)/(2kB), B=2kB*M/C. Every power jump is split; the scaled kernel avoids a growing integrating factor.
numeric_method.translation: Separate direct positive nested quadrature of2kB*T_reference*nu*N0exp(-nu*t). It is accumulated over the union of logical observation intervals, once per distinct case/precision/order, and reused across refinement grids. It is not derived from thermal energy subtraction.
numeric_method.quadrature: Legendre roots/weights are generated in Decimal at80/120digits for16/32nodes; binary cosine seeds are Newton-refined before weights are evaluated.
numeric_method.empty_inventory: Exactly N=M=allreleasechannels=0 and T=T0+exactsegmentedinput/C; no numerical release model is evaluated.
numeric_method.scales: Each count/energy channel has its own final emitted or gross channel budget. Temperature uses maximum resolved reference excursion over the whole case, thermal change uses C times that excursion. Gross input/debit scales remain separate and never replace temperature/thermal scales. Exactly zero budgets require exactly zero error.
numeric_method.orders: Three successive saved final values supply finite self-orders. Count, temperature and translation must resolve at least3.4; other signed/cancellation-sensitive quantities are reported without inventing an order. No finite-reference error-ratio shortcut is used.

checks.finding: For C*Tdot=P-nu*N*(D+I+2*kB*T), shifting T by A=(D+I)/(2*kB) gives a positive damping coefficient. B(t)=2*kB*M(t)/C leads to the implemented exp(B(s)-B(t)) kernel, whose exponent is nonpositive for s<=t.
T0+(T0+A)*expm1(-B) is algebraically (T0+A)*exp(-B)-A. This avoids a growing integrating factor and retains a small cooling change through expm1.
N=N0*exp(-nu*t) and M=-N0*expm1(-nu*t) match exactly zero activation barrier; nonzero barrier rejects. Empty inventory uses the analytic prescribed-input temperature only.

The verifier reconstructs logical times as exact represented-Fractions from segment index and local step count. Reference translation intervals include the union of all observation times and all power boundaries. Rounded time_s is checked separately.

Translation accumulates direct positive quadrature of 2*kB*T_reference*nu*N_reference over logical intervals. It is not derived from thermal-energy subtraction. The energy residual is a separate consistency check.
